name: okf
description: OKF toolkit and agent skills for v0.2 authoring, legacy consumption, validation, explicit migration, knowledge upkeep, and Git history backfill.

interface.shortDescription: Author, validate, consume, and migrate OKF bundles.
interface.longDescription: Provides open-knowledge-format for authoring, reading, validation, viewer and migration, okf-maintain for fingerprint-bound repository review, and okf-backfill for Git history reconstruction.
defaultPrompt: Use $open-knowledge-format to validate this OKF bundle.
Use $open-knowledge-format to design an OKF bundle.
Use $open-knowledge-format to migrate this legacy bundle to OKF v0.2.
Use $okf-maintain to review repository knowledge after this code change.
Use $okf-backfill to reconstruct draft knowledge from this Git history.
